instruction: Could you center the text layer completely on the canvas? I need it positioned exactly in the center both horizontally and vertically.

metadata.explanation: Task requires fully centering the text layer both horizontally and vertically on the canvas. The evaluator finds the complete bounding box of the text and checks if both horizontal and vertical centers are within 10% tolerance of the image's center point.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH horizontal and vertical centering as required by the instruction
Metric logic correctly identifies text boundaries by finding dark pixels (< 128) in grayscale image
Center calculation is mathematically correct: (left_most + right_most) / 2 for both x and y axes
Returns 1.0 only when BOTH horizontal AND vertical centering conditions are met
Postconfig properly exports GIMP image to PNG format for pixel-level verification
10% tolerance is reasonable for 'fully centered' verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add edge case handling: if no text pixels are found (all pixels >= 128), the bounding box variables remain at initial values (left_most=width, right_most=0), causing incorrect calculations. Should detect this case and return 0.0
Consider adding logging to show how far off-center the text is when check fails, to help with debugging
The pixel threshold of 128 assumes dark text on light background. This works for the specific 'orange_background.xcf' file but may fail with inverted color schemes
